title: Senior Data Analyst - Experimentation & A/B Testing (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Investigating 770 Million User Interactions Across a 100TB Data Lake

When a platform serves 770 million users, every optimization from reward mechanics to SDK integrations needs to be grounded in data. The Rewarded Analytics team builds the internal dashboards, alerting systems, and data pipelines that monitor the user funnel, traffic engagement, and reward consistency.

SQL and Python power deep-dive investigations and automated 100 terabyte-sized data analyses queried through Trino. Using Tableau as the main visualization tool, stakeholders have access to real-time insights on the product performance. Airflow orchestrates the pipelines that keep everything up to date. This team provides the data that turns questions into answers: every A/B experiment the product team runs, every anomaly a publisher flags, and every new SDK integration. These answers guide all the business decisions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- Data analyst with a strong technical foundation. You have 5+ years as a Data Analyst and work fluently in both SQL and Python, writing complex queries, big data optimizations, and analysis pipelines to support product and growth initiatives.

- Master of experimentation and A/B testing. You have deep experience designing experiments, calculating sample sizes, managing variance reduction techniques, and analyzing A/B/n tests to ensure statistically sound business decisions.

- Statistically grounded. You can reason confidently about core statistical concepts-hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, power analysis, and Bayesian vs. Frequentist approaches-and apply them to real-world product decisions.

- Not a stranger to anomaly detection. You have experience working with anomaly detection algorithms and approaches like distribution analysis and cross-population comparison to monitor test guardrail metrics and identify unexpected shifts in experiment data.

- You own the systems, not just your slice. You understand the end-to-end telemetry and feature flagging systems that power experimentation. You can speak to data flows, event tracking pipelines, architecture tradeoffs, and why things were built the way they were.

- Automation-minded across the stack. You think beyond one-off test analyses and build automated experiment reporting dashboards, reusable analytical frameworks, and data visibility solutions. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or experiment platforms (e.g., Optimizely, GrowthBook) is a strong plus.

- Collaborative and business-aware. You work closely with product managers, engineers, and growth leads to translate complex statistical results into clear, actionable recommendations that drive executive decision-making.

 

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

title: Director, Air & Car Rental Partnerships
description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 38,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020-2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

As Director, Airline & Car Rental Partnerships , you will lead Engine’s strategy and execution across air and car rental supply - owning senior relationships with airlines and car rental partners and shaping how these suppliers are integrated into Engine’s platform.

This role serves as the senior external face of Engine to airline and car rental partners and is responsible for securing, growing, and evolving strategic partnerships that improve customer experience, coverage, and long-term economics. You will bring deep industry credibility, existing executive relationships, and strong judgment to help Engine scale Flights and Cars as core capabilities.

This is a senior role operating at the intersection of supply strategy, product, commercial, and pricing. You will act as the single-threaded owner for air supply initiatives, driving clear recommendations, execution, and outcomes across airline partnerships, connectivity models, and commercial alignment.

This role provides deep airline domain expertise, structured judgment, and execution leadership to inform and support those decisions as flights continue to scale as a core Engine capability.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the strategy and execution for Engine’s air and car rental supply ecosystem aligned to 2026 priorities

• Lead and deepen senior relationships with airlines and car rental partners, serving as a trusted executive counterpart

• Identify, negotiate, and activate direct supplier agreements in partnership with executive leadership

• Shape Engine’s preferred connectivity and partnership approach by carrier, rental brand, and market

• Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for supplier coverage, connectivity, and commercial alignment

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Operations to translate strategy into delivered outcomes

• Provide clear recommendations on tradeoffs across customer experience, coverage, performance, and margin

• Track and report on air supply KPIs to measure progress against strategy

• Monitor industry dynamics across airline commercial, distribution technology, regulatory, and competitive landscapes to inform Engine’s long-term positioning

What We’re Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in airline distribution, supply strategy, partnerships, or commercial roles

• Deep existing relationships with airlines (and ideally car rental brands), with demonstrated ability to engage credibly at the executive level

• Strong understanding of airline distribution models (GDS, NDC, ancillaries, fare structures) and car rental commercial constructs

• Proven track record negotiating and scaling complex supplier partnerships with meaningful commercial impact

• Strong strategic judgment with the ability to balance experience, coverage, performance, and economics

• Clear, executive-level written and verbal communication skills

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and making tradeoff-driven decisions

Nice to Have

• Experience at an airline, OTA, GDS, aggregator

title: Deputy Editor, Future Perfect
description:
Vox Media employees thrive on innovation and change while ambitiously seeking to master their subject areas, hone their craft, and improve their communities. We help smart, talented, creative professionals make a meaningful impact in media, technology, and the world around them.
Our Future Perfect section is an especially exciting place for that mission to come alive. Future Perfect covers the world through a particular prism: What are the best ways to do good in this world? Inspired and informed by effective altruism, Future Perfect strives to shine a light on neglected stories that have, or will have, a profound impact on the lives of billions of humans and animals.
Vox is looking for a deputy editor for Future Perfect. We want a self-starter who will help drive daily coverage on Future Perfect, oversee our freelance program, and edit and manage three of our writers: Sigal Samuel, Kenny Torrella and Marina Bolotnikova. This person will also assist the Future Perfect editor in overall management of the section and its staff, and will run the section in conjunction with their fellow deputy editor when the section editor is absent. This is a permanent full-time staff position.
Among our key subject areas include:

• Global poverty and public health

• The catastrophic and existential threats, both natural and technological, that humanity faces

• Animal welfare and factory farming

• The growth of progress studies and evidence-based policies that can boost sustainable growth for all

• The frontiers of artificial intelligence and biotechnology

• The philosophies and practices surrounding philanthropy and altruism, and the moral and ethical questions that underpin individual and policy choices.

Since its launch in 2018, Future Perfect has developed a loyal following for its idiosyncratic, mission-driven approach to news. Our coverage is animated by a baseline question: what’s truly important that we need to cover -- not what’s in the news, not what’s trending on Twitter, but the stories that we think truly matter for human and animal lives and the future? Then we go ahead and do those stories today.

• Editing our biweekly newsletter on Processing Meat, written by Kenny Torrella

• Commission and edit occasional pieces for the Future Perfect site

What you’ll bring:

• Minimum 5 years’ experience editing, or equivalent

• Strong managerial philosophy and communication skills; previous management experience is desirable but not a requirement

• A passion for mentoring, managing and editing writers

• A demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories, as well as well as skill with handling collaborations with audio and video teams

• An understanding of the importance of careful editing, coupled with the ability to build and shepherd big ideas

• Experience in and enthusiasm for diving into research literature, particularly in economics, psychology, sociology, political science, biology/medicine, and computer science is desirable

To apply, please submit a résumé, cover letter, and 3-5 clips that you’ve edited or written (clips can either be linked in your cover letter or included as additional pages to your cover letter).

How do we give patients more leverage when they're facing an unreasonable medical bill?

description:
This is a remote position.

Location: Remote across India; may transition to onsite in the future Experience: 10+ years in software, including 3+ as an architect or tech lead on multi-tenant SaaS, and atleast 6+ months shipping production software mainly through AI coding agents.

The role. You design the Spektra’s SaaS modular platforms and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. You own the boundaries between the .NET/Angular core and the Next.js/React/Python modules, the contracts between them, and the specs, templates and guardrails our coding agents work from. You lead by writing specs and reviewing output, not by typing code: every implementation is generated by agents and verified by you and your team.

What you'll do

•
Platform architecture

• Own the target architecture: core services (identity, tenancy, entitlements, lab engine, learner record) and independently deployed modules.

• Define module contracts: manifests, APIs, events, shared header/shell, branding, and the per-module data boundary (own schema/database, no cross-module reads).

• Make and record decisions as ADRs: edge routing (Azure Front Door), identity (B2C / Entra External ID, server-side sessions, per-module app registrations), data, and hosting.

• Plan the safe migration off legacy V1 services onto vNext, one path or feature at a time, with rollback at every step.

•
The agent-driven engineering system

• Design how work flows from idea to production with agents: spec → plan → task breakdown → agent implementation → automated checks → human review → deploy.

• Own the standing context agents load every session: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md , architecture rules, coding standards, skills, MCP servers and hooks. Review changes to them like code.

• Maintain the golden module template (our TaskBoard reference module) so a new module goes from scaffold to QA in days.

• Set the automated guardrails agents must pass: typecheck, lint, dependency-boundary rules, contract tests, row-level-security tests, secret scanning, conformance checks.

• Decide which agent, model and mode fits which task, and track cost, speed and defect rates per workflow.

•
Quality, security and operations

• Review the highest-risk agent changes yourself: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, payments/credits, infrastructure and data migrations.

• Threat-model new modules and AI features (prompt injection, credential leakage, abuse of lab environments).

• Define SLOs, observability and incident practice for the platform; make sure every environment can be rebuilt from infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/Terraform).

•
AI product architecture

• Architect AI-powered product features such as the AI Trainer (realtime voice, screen understanding, lab validation tools) and Lab Studio (AI-generated labs, guides and checks).

• Choose and integrate model providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic and others), with evaluation suites, guardrails and cost controls.

•
Leadership

• Coach developers on spec writing, agent orchestration and critical review.

• Work with product, the .NET core team and partners on roadmap and trade-offs; explain them clearly to non-engineers.

Requirements

Must have

• Deep, current experience with both halves of our stack: ASP.NET Core/C#/SQL Server and Angular on one side; TypeScript, React/Next.js and Python on the other. You can read any of it fluently and spot what an agent got wrong.

• Proven architecture of multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, RBAC/entitlements, white-labelling, API versioning.

• Strong identity and security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, Azure AD B2C or Entra, session design, OWASP Top 10, secrets management.

• Azure in production: Container Apps or AKS, App Service, Front Door or App Gateway, Key Vault, managed identities, Bicep or Terraform.

• Demonstrated daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Copilot agents or similar) to ship production systems, including multi-agent/parallel workflows.

description:
This role will act as the operation’s customer support system. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

title: Script Writer - Kannada (GyanTV)
description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

• Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

• Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

• Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

• Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

• Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

• Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

• Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Senior Engineer, Full-Stack - Forge (R6244)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

About Shield AI 
Shield AI is a defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We build autonomy systems for air, maritime, space, and other platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 
Forge is the engineering platform used to build, integrate, test, and operate Hivemind capabilities. It connects autonomy developers with the applications, services, compute, data, and workflows they need to move from local development to deployed systems. 
The Role 
We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help shape the future of physical AI by building tools to develop, train, and validate autonomous systems. You will work across TypeScript and React applications, backend services, APIs, and Python data workflows, with an emphasis on extensibility and reuse. You will build Forge capabilities for simulation, synthetic data generation, training, and test and evaluation, helping engineers turn ideas into proven autonomy capabilities. Working directly with Hivemind Pilot developers, Hivemind Solutions teams, and domain experts, you will translate complex workflows into reliable applications and reusable services. You will own features from user needs and design through implementation, deployment, and support. 
This role suits a generalist who wants meaningful ownership, enjoys moving between frontend and backend work, and is curious about the systems that connect them. You will help shape technical decisions and deploy and troubleshoot containerized services alongside platform engineers. Practical Kubernetes experience is a plus, particularly supporting applications in cloud or on-premises environments.

title: Senior Product Manager, Toast Delivery Services
description:
*EST OR CST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Delivery is one of the hardest parts of running a restaurant. Whether an order goes out with the restaurant's own driver or a Toast Delivery Services courier, a lot has to go right: the food has to be ready when the driver arrives, the right driver has to get the right order, and the guest needs to know where it is. When something slips, the restaurant has to make it right fast. Today much of that still depends on a manager watching a screen and making judgment calls in the middle of a rush.

Our vision is to make running delivery effortless: one place to dispatch, track and manage every delivery order. Because Toast sits at the center of the restaurant, we can see both sides of every delivery, the kitchen and the road. That lets us build smarter dispatch, catch problems before the guest notices, and use AI to take on the tedious work of exceptions and refunds.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

As a Senior PM on Delivery, you'll own that roadmap and ship it. You'll work closely with the Guest team on the consumer experience, and with POS, Order Management and Toast's AI teams. If you like technical problems that show up directly in a restaurant's dinner rush and a guest's evening, this is the role.

• Own the roadmap for your area of Toast Delivery, and decide what gets built next based on what makes delivery easier and more profitable for restaurants.

• Improve how orders get dispatched, whether to the restaurant's own drivers or Toast Delivery Services couriers, so food goes out on time and operators always know where things stand.

• Partner with the Guest team on the guest side of delivery: ordering, live tracking and quick resolution when something goes wrong.

• Take the manual work out of exceptions and refunds. Decide where AI helps and where simple rules work better, then ship it with guardrails operators can trust.

• Shape the next generation of delivery at Toast: AI-assisted dispatch, proactive alerts that catch problems before guests notice, and smarter ways to match delivery capacity to what the kitchen can handle.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• A strong self-starter: you find the most important problem, get the context you need and move. 

• A proven track record owning a product roadmap and driving measurable outcomes, not just shipping features.

• Technical fluency: you're comfortable going deep with engineers on integrations and data. You stay anchored on what it changes for the restaurant or guest.

• Strong instincts for the busy restaurant operator, someone running a dinner rush without an ops analyst, and for what makes a guest choose to order direct.

• Comfort working with external partners and integrations, where some of what shapes your product is outside your direct control.

• Experience in delivery, logistics, marketplaces or other real-time operational products is a plus.

Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. The People Intelligence team builds the internal software Applied Intuition's leaders use to run the company as it grows and scales to many thousands of employees: tools for performance management, team planning, headcount and budget, organizational insight, and the everyday experience of working here. You'll join a small team where every engineer owns products end to end: working directly with company leaders as customers, turning operational bottlenecks into durable systems, and shipping to production continuously. - Keep sensitive people and financial data correct and access-controlled: identity-aware access, authorization enforced in code, and tests that catch regressions before deploy

- Work directly with company leaders and partner teams (People, Finance, IT, and others) to decide what gets built

title: Marketing Lead
description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
You are the PM of marketing. You own the strategy, the key partnerships, and the press, and you keep everything marketing does tied tightly to the product, the business, and the technical teams building it. This is the most generalist role on the team. You set the direction, you connect the dots, and you are just as comfortable writing the narrative as you are running the plan behind it.

What You'll Do

• Own the overall marketing strategy and turn the company roadmap into a story worth telling

• Drive key partnerships that expand our reach, credibility, and distribution

• Own press and media relations, and act as a trusted external voice for Menlo

• Keep marketing aligned with product, business, and engineering, so the message always matches the machine

• Set positioning and messaging for Asimov and the Menlo Platform

• Build and prioritize the marketing roadmap, then decide what ships and what waits

• Plan and run launches that make each milestone land

• Measure what is working, kill what is not, and double down where it counts

• Shape and grow the marketing team over time

What We Look For

• A generalist marketer who has worn many hats and can move between strategy and execution without friction

• A track record of owning marketing strategy and shipping launches that moved the needle

• Real strength in partnerships and press, with the network and instincts to match

• Credibility with engineers and researchers, and the ability to translate their work for the rest of the world

• Comfort being the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone pointed the same way

• A bias to action and genuine comfort in an early-stage, fast-changing environment

• Excellent writing and storytelling

Nice to Have

• A background in deep tech, hardware, robotics, or AI

• An existing press and partnership network you can activate on day one

• Experience building a marketing function from close to zero

• Enough technical fluency to hold your own in a room full of builders

Why Join Menlo
We are a physical AI company building real robots, and marketing sits at the center of the story. You own strategy, partnerships, and press outright, with the mandate to shape the whole function and a direct line to product, research, and leadership, with no layers to fight through. You get to build in public at a company where the work speaks for itself, with the room to shape the function as we grow.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

title: Engineering Manager - Ads
description:
About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.

• Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.

• Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.

• Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.

title: Product Manager, Evals
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

Evals at Exa

 

The Evals Team sits at the heart of our mission. We train foundational models for search. Our goal is to build systems that can instantly filter the world's knowledge to exactly what you want, no matter how complex your query. Basically, put the web into an extremely powerful database. And to do that well, we need to measure what “good search” actually means. That’s where you come in.

 

As a Product Manager on the Evals team, you will partner with research, product, GTM, and engineering to oversee the quality and completeness of our evaluation data. You will be responsible for ensuring our search models are being evaluated against comprehensive and high-quality datasets, across numerous domains. You’ll manage relationships with external vendors and make key strategic decisions on what data is important for our evals - and acquire it. Your work will play a key role in Exa’s mission of a perfect information society.

 

Who You Are

- Hustler in negotiating, securing, and managing relationships with external vendors

- Care and excellence in writing. At Exa we value human communications free of AI generated text

- High ownership and attention to detail

- Strong numerical literacy and technical background. CS/EE degree, production engineering experience, or equivalent depth earned on the job

 

What You Could Do

- Build specific, localized eval feedback and signal

- Write a manifesto of what perfect search means

- Define metrics and success criteria for our evaluation data suites

- Partner closely with ML researchers, data engineers, infra engineers, and product to shape the data loops that improve our search models

 

Logistics

- Location: This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

- Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

title: Co-Op, Automated Systems Engineer
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is looking for a hands-on engineering co-op to help build and test the automated systems that run our laboratory workflows. Reporting to a senior manager on the Automated Systems Engineering team and paired with a day-to-day mentor, you will work alongside engineers and scientists on real workcells that are being deployed.

This is a lab-floor role. You will spend your time integrating instruments and troubleshooting systems that run live experiments. By the end of the co-op you should own a meaningful piece of a system and understand how scientific goals turn into working hardware.

Along the way you will see how scientific objectives become scoped technical requirements, how science, hardware, controls, and software teams coordinate interfaces on a shared system, and how automated experiments generate the structured, high-quality data that feeds AI-driven experimental design. You will also get hands-on time with emerging lab technology, including machine vision, advanced sensors, and automated scheduling software.

What You'll Be Building

• Support cross-functional requirements gathering and project documentation using established team templates and execution guidelines.

• Assist in converting manual scientific protocols into automation concept designs through process mapping, step timing, and identification of automation candidates.

• Research new instruments and technologies, and help evaluate them for physical integration capability and fit with scientific workflows.

• Contribute to concept design documentation, system architecture diagrams, and interface definitions for workcell- and instrument-level projects.

• Maintain and update the federated factory layout model, producing layout drawings and 3D models that account for robotics envelopes, human ergonomics, and hazard zones.

• Support feasibility assessments for proposed automation opportunities and help document lab automation best practices and lessons learned.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Robotics, or Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related field

• Available for a full-time co-op term (typically 4 to 6 months) on-site in Cambridge

• Working knowledge of Python through coursework, projects, or prior internships

• Curiosity, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and work through unfamiliar problems

• Clear communication and comfort working with people across different technical backgrounds

Bonus Points For

• Wet lab exposure through coursework, undergraduate research, or a prior role involving pipetting, sample handling, or assay work

• Familiarity with CAD and some experience with rapid prototyping or 3D printing

• Experience with automated liquid handlers (Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons) or robotic arms

• Coursework or project experience with control systems, PID loops, or microcontrollers

• Prior robotics competition, research lab, or iGEM-style team experience

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

• You understand how accelerator compute, memory, and networking topology constrain AI workloads, and don't treat hardware as a black box.

• Experience with LLM inference serving engines and technologies, e.g. vLLM, SGLang, Mooncake, NIM, Dynamo, LMCache.

What You Will Learn

• Where co-design of AI hardware and software translates into unique latency and throughput performance.

• How to scale disaggregated inference services on Kubernetes while balancing performance, reliability, and tactical tradeoffs.

• What makes enterprise AI deployments successful: from technical requirements through software delivery, cluster-scale validation, and production ownership.

• Why customer insights from the field shape the best products.

• How to build agentic workflows for asymmetric impact.

•
Education: High school diploma or equivalent; further education or certification in administrative services, business administration, or a related field

title: Europe Trade Compliance Lead
description:
About the Team

Tax and Trade helps shape how OpenAI brings new technologies to the world. We help build the foundations for global expansion and new hardware businesses, combining expertise in tax, customs and export controls with creative problem-solving.

Our work brings together technology, regulation and global commerce. We solve new problems with teams across OpenAI and use data, AI and automation to support a growing business. Joining the team means helping turn ambitious ideas into products and capabilities that reach people around the world.

Based in Dublin, Ireland, with a hybrid schedule of three office days each week. Relocation support is available for new hires.

About the Role

You will build and run OpenAI’s trade compliance program across Europe. Your remit spans cross-border shipping routes, partner and supplier arrangements, daily trade operations and compliance oversight for the legal entities involved. You will work with Legal, direct tax and indirect tax teams to design structures that meet trade requirements while improving cost and speed. We are looking for someone who can build from the ground up, make sound business decisions and stay close to execution. You will also help set a new benchmark for how trade compliance programs use AI to improve decisions, strengthen controls and support growth.

In this role, you will:

- Design compliant trading and supply-chain structures with Legal, direct tax and indirect tax teams. Evaluate company, transaction, partner and supplier arrangements to improve cost, speed and operating reliability.

- Build the European trade compliance program and launch cross-border shipping routes. Put customs, import, export, sanctions and cross-border e-commerce requirements into workable processes.

- Own ongoing European import, export and returns operations, including customs warehousing where needed. Manage brokers and service providers, resolve issues and maintain reliable service as volume and complexity grow.

- Set and test compliance policies and controls for each legal entity. Maintain required authorizations, respond to rule changes, prepare for audits, resolve gaps and report risks to leaders.

- Personally manage relationships with customs and other trade authorities. Work with Legal to defend compliance positions and programs, respond to audits and inquiries, and resolve issues.

- Use AI to improve trade analysis, document review and ongoing monitoring. Build and test these processes, retain human review and decision records, and measure gains in accuracy and speed.

- Use shipment, inventory and customs data to investigate problems and compare options. Define the data and systems the program needs, and track whether processes and controls work.

- Bring business, supply chain, Finance, Tax, Legal and technology teams together to turn strategy into clear procedures, training and measurable operating improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep European customs expertise, including EU customs law, classification, valuation, origin and importer/exporter responsibilities. Practical experience applying different customs valuation methods and a working knowledge of import, export and sanctions requirements.

- A record of building trade programs from the ground up and making business decisions that balance compliance, cost, speed and operating needs, in partnership with Legal and Tax.

- Direct experience managing hardware imports and bonded warehouse compliance across multiple European countries. Personal responsibility for decisions, controls and ongoing operations.

- Experience personally managing regulatory relationships and defending compliance programs, positions and actions in reviews, audits or inquiries.

- Ability to investigate detailed data, question assumptions and recommend action. Practical experience using AI tools and checking their outputs.

- Experience leading work across internal teams, partners and suppliers, including Europe

title: Account Supervisor
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together - powerfully and intentionally - to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups - Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. 

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.  

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

description: Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. title: Remote Customer Operations Coordinator (SAP Implementation )
description:
Customer Operations Coordinator for a fast-growing beauty and personal care brand that's moving from Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central to SAP S/4HANA . You'll support the customer operations side of the project, from process documentation and data validation through testing, go-live and post-launch support.
What you'll do:

• Document current order-to-cash processes and help review the new SAP workflows

• Take part in SAP design workshops and capture requirements, questions and action items

• Write and run test scripts (system integration, user acceptance and regression testing) for sales orders, pricing, fulfillment, invoicing, returns, credits and EDI

• Log and track defects through to resolution and retesting

• Validate migrated data: customer records, ship-to locations, pricing, payment terms and EDI settings

• Test EDI and 3PL/warehouse integrations (850, 855, 856, 810, 846)

• Document requirements for major retailers: Walmart, Target, Ulta, Walgreens, CVS and Amazon

• Support cutover, go-live and early post-launch support; build SOPs, training materials and job aids

Required:

• 2-4 years in customer operations, order management, supply chain or ERP support

• Strong knowledge of order-to-cash: orders, customer master data, pricing, fulfillment, invoicing

• Intermediate to advanced Excel

• Strong documentation, follow-up and problem-solving skills

Preferred:

• SAP S/4HANA or SAP SD (order-to-cash) experience, or experience supporting an SAP implementation

•
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central , which is highly desirable

• Testing experience: test scripts, user acceptance testing, defect tracking

• EDI and 3PL/warehouse system experience

• CPG, beauty or personal care, or retail experience with big-box retailer compliance
